user.title: Connect to LG Projector
user.description: Enter the IP address of your LG Projector. Make sure it is turned on.

pairing.title: Pairing LG Projector
pairing.description: Please accept the pairing request on your LG Projector screen, then click Submit.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the projector. Is it on and is the IP correct?
error.auth_error: Pairing was rejected or timed out. Please try again.

init.title: Configure LG Projector Settings
init.description: Configure an optional HDR sensor to dynamically filter the picture mode dropdown (SDR vs HDR vs Dolby Vision). If the sensor is unknown, unavailable, or not set, all modes are shown.
